source.commit_body:
Fixes a same-day-reaction edge case in the EARN_BOOST proximity helper
(database/models/core.py) and its V6 volume-amplifier counterpart
(volume_amplifier.py).

The bug: bisect_left / range(0, W+1) accepted delta=0 as "earnings
upcoming", so a signal computed AT THE CLOSE of an earnings reaction
day (BMO same-day, or AMC previous-day post-shift) hit cohort 'pre1'
with full proximity = 1.0. The score-stage boost and volume-amplifier
suppression both fired on prices that already contained the gap.

NBIS Apr 29 BMO at 08:00 was the discovery case: live recompute hit
the 75-79 bucket, triggered the +17.7pp pre1 75-79 lift cell on a
post-reaction signal, and inflated the score. The same arithmetic
applied to V6 earnings volume suppression.

Fix:
- bisect_left -> bisect_right and 1 <= delta <= W in the three
  days-to-earn helpers (_days_to_next_earnings,
  _days_to_earn_from_sorted, _days_to_next_earnings_for inherits).
- range(0, W+1) -> range(1, W+1) in _earn_nearest_d_from_set.
- effective_date > today (was >=) in _query_earn_nearest_d_db.
- _earnings_supp_strength rejects nearest_d < 1 (was nearest_d < 0).

Schema migration (EarningsDate model):
- New effective_date DateField column (nullable, indexed on
  (symbol, effective_date)) — precomputed reaction day. BMO/intraday:
  matches `date`. AMC (call_time >= 16:00): next trading day.
- ensure_schema() runs idempotent ALTER TABLE + CREATE INDEX + bulk
  UPDATE backfill via SQL CASE (DAYOFWEEK arithmetic for AMC weekday
  shift). Backfill processes 16,420 rows, with 8,588 AMC rows
  correctly shifted forward.
- EarningsDate.build() recomputes effective_date on every save via
  iv_crush_model.compute_effective_date so daily updates stay in
  sync if call_time is edited later.
- _load_effective_earnings_dates now reads the column directly
  (single SELECT, no per-row compute_effective_date Python call) with
  a fallback path for any rows missing the precomputed value.

Validated edge cases (NBIS BMO Apr 29 + NEO AMC Apr 28):
- BMO Apr 29, signal Apr 29: d=None (no boost, no suppression) ✓
- BMO Apr 29, signal Apr 28: d=1 (pre1 boost + suppression) ✓
- AMC Apr 28, signal Apr 29: d=None (post-reaction) ✓
- AMC Apr 28, signal Apr 28: d=1 (pre1, gap tonight) ✓

Score-stage change → ALGORITHM_VERSION bump + recalculate +
canonical seeded MC at N=300+ × 8 windows required as the ship gate
(see Score-stage Change Protocol in CLAUDE.md). EVR-1 + EVR-2
follow-up sweeps drafted in known-issues.md but not committed in
this PR — they belong with the user's pending Gate B/C doc edits.

What is NOT in this PR (deferred):
- monte_carlo.py / backtest_cascade.py / 15dte variants still call
  compute_effective_date() inline at their own earnings-loading
  sites. Functionally correct (same effective dates produced); a
  pure speed follow-up would migrate them to read effective_date
  directly.
- find_spanning_earnings retains its `entry < ed` strict semantics
  (correct for span detection — different question than proximity).
- is_bmo boolean column omitted; (date, effective_date) pair already
  encodes BMO-vs-AMC.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>
